relevance_note: Narrative review of retinal vasculitis that mentions TNFAIP3/A20 haploinsufficiency only at group level, citing ref 12: "Patients present early in life with oral ulcers, pathergy, dermal abscesses, chorioretinal scarring, and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis." No identifiable person with a TNFAIP3 variant is described.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; no script. The only HA20 content is a group-level summary of reference [12**] in 'New insights into pathogenesis' and the Key Points; no sex, age, variant or feature is given for any individual, so no individuals, variants or phenotype rows. The patient in Figures 1-2 (25 year-old Saudi male) has Behcet's disease, with no TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis stated, so out of scope. The '207 patients' and other series counts are from cited studies, not this paper's own cohort, so cohort_size_as_stated is null. n_patients_reported is null: no count of TNFAIP3 patients is stated. No contradictions found.

study_type.span: This review focuses on new developments in the understanding and treatment of retinal vasculitis.
